optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Site Project Coordinator, Solar Farm Construction
professionalSummary: Site project coordinator with three years of experience on two utility-scale solar farm sites, maintaining weekly construction schedules with four subcontractors' progress reports.
Recorded daily site diaries and permit-to-work registers in accordance with site procedures, audited quarterly by the site health and safety adviser with no findings.
Prepared weekly progress reports for the developer's site representative, with reports and comments filed in the site folder.
Tracked material deliveries against the schedule in a delivery log, resolving supplier queries and noting those requiring site instruction.
Authored hand-over condition notes at mechanical completion and grid connection milestones, countersigned by the site project manager.
experienceHighlights: Maintained construction schedule updates weekly, reflecting subcontractor progress.
Recorded daily site diary and permit-to-work register per site procedures.
Prepared weekly progress reports for developer site representative.
Tracked material deliveries and documented queries and instructions.
Wrote hand-over condition notes at key milestones, countersigned by site project manager.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample includes one month of schedule updates, one week of site diary and permit-to-work register pages, one weekly progress report, and one milestone hand-over note, with site folder references as verification.
skills: Site diary and permit-to-work register recording
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s activities and responsibilities on two utility-scale solar farm sites, but do not provide evidence of independent ownership, leadership, or production deployment beyond the described tasks.
